result.summary: A narrow one-way residential street with continuous sidewalks on both sides but lacking formal pedestrian crossing infrastructure. The environment is low-speed by design, though sightlines at the intersection are partially obscured by parked vehicles and vegetation.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: No painted crosswalks are visible at the intersection, which may lead to driver confusion regarding pedestrian priority.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked cars and large bushes near the corner block the view between pedestrians on the sidewalk and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and right corners in the foreground

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian space and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten crossing distance and improve sightlines.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: The street is a typical residential corridor with continuous sidewalks but lacks any formal pedestrian crossing infrastructure or traffic control devices. Parked cars along both curbs create significant sightline obstructions for pedestrians attempting to cross the roadway.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along both curbs block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians at potential crossing points.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both sides of the street

hazards.name: Lack of Crossing Infrastructure
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks or pedestrian warning signs are visible, providing no designated safe space for crossing.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Cracking and uneven asphalt in the roadway and sidewalk areas could present trip hazards.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or cushions to ensure low vehicle speeds on this long, straight residential stretch.

result.summary: This residential environment features continuous sidewalks along row houses but lacks essential intersection safety infrastructure. There are no marked crosswalks, curb ramps, or visible traffic control devices at the immediate junction shown.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The intersection lacks marked crosswalks, which fails to communicate pedestrian right-of-way to drivers.

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The absence of curb ramps creates a physical barrier for pedestrians with mobility aids, strollers, or luggage.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles close to the intersection corners may obscure pedestrians from the view of approaching motorists.

interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian crossing locations.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install standardized curb ramps with detectable warning pads at all corners to ensure accessibility.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Implement parking restrictions near the intersection to improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: This residential environment features a one-way street with continuous sidewalks but lacks essential pedestrian safety infrastructure at the intersection. The absence of marked crosswalks, curb ramps, and clear sightlines due to parked cars creates a hazardous environment for pedestrians, particularly those with limited mobility.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossings
hazards.description: The intersection lacks any painted markings to alert drivers to pedestrian crossing locations.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the intersection corners block the view of pedestrians for oncoming traffic.

hazards.name: Inaccessible Curbs
hazards.description: The lack of curb ramps prevents safe and easy access for individuals with mobility impairments.
